title: feat(plugin-auth)!: an organization administrator reads their judged client address; the console's retired MFA notices are gone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X2ArVyEECU1nJDS63wR7Z1H)_

Fixes #31030

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the published `@object-ui/i18n` packs (all eleven) drop `console.organizationMfa.needsTwoFactor` and `.nowRequired`, which had no reader outside the removed notices. The widening half: a new served read, `GET /api/v1/auth/client-address`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no access-policy key, client-address read or console notice, and `content/docs/**` teaches no per-organization access policy; its `allowed_ip_ranges` section in `permissions/authentication.mdx` is the deployment's own list, whose platform-admin read it names correctly.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:组织管理员(在当前组织有 `setup.write`)可通过新接口 `GET /api/v1/auth/client-address` 看到服务器判定的自己的 IP;auth 插件自挂的路由在进程内读会话时也会按组织的 IP 白名单判定;控制台删掉了组织表单上针对已退役 `require_mfa` 列的两条提示及其文案。
- 为什么改:组织管理员保存「允许的 IP 范围」前,原本只能从保存被拒的报错里得知自己的地址(旧接口只对平台管理员开放);另外 auth 插件自挂路由读会话时不判组织 IP 名单,与 better-auth 自身路由的判定不一致。
- 风险与回滚:新接口只回答调用者自己的地址,查询参数一律拒收;中间件只给 `/api/v1/auth/*` 下的会话读带上地址,不在名单内的会话会在这些路由上被结束(`ip_not_allowed`)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`(新路由与地址中间件)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`(会话读的 door 参数)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/client-address-read.ts`(准入判定)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/org-admin-client-address-read.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 4 条全绿:组织管理员 200、普通成员 403 PERMISSION_DENIED、匿名 401、组织管理员读平台接口 403。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**S7: an organization administrator reads their judged address.** `GET /api/v1/auth/client-address` (new, mounted by `auth-plugin.ts` ahead of the catch-all, beside the platform-admin `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/client-address`) answers the same `{ clientAddress, trustProxy }`: the address the `access_policy.allowed_ip_ranges` save check judges. The caller is resolved through core's `resolveRequestExecutionContext` with the settings door's parameter set, and admitted by `judgeOrganizationAddressReader` (`client-address-read.ts`): no caller is `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`; a held session is `403` with its posture's code (`judgeHeldSession`); a caller without `setup.write` in their current organization is `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`; an unreachable permission store is `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. It answers the caller's own address only: the query set is closed and empty (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR` for any parameter), and the answer is `Cache-Control: no-store`. The route is a new row in `auth-route-ledger.ts` (objectstack-mount, server-only) and in the ledger conformance pin.

**D3: an objectstack mount's in-process session read judges the organization's IP list.** A middleware on `${basePath}/*` establishes the request's address with `AuthManager.resolveClientAddress` (the D5 gate's rule: `server.trustProxy` decides whether forwarded headers count) and runs the rest of the request in a better-auth request state carrying it (`runAtMountDoor`, `request-client-address.ts`). `customSession` passes that address as the `door` to `enforceSessionControls` when no `ctx.request` is present (`readMountDoor`), so `gateAdmin`, the authorized-AI-assistant routes, session revoke, add member and the other routes that call `auth.api.getSession` in process end a session outside the organization's Allowed IP ranges (`revoke_reason: ip_not_allowed`), as better-auth's own routes already did. Outside a mount no door is open, so data requests outside the auth mount are judged by neither list, as before. Measured that the mount has an established address (peer, or forwarded under `trustProxy`), so the seat's ruling (pass the address) applies.

**D2: no heartbeat before the switch judgement, through the real route.** A new pin drives `POST /organization/set-active` on a real better-auth instance: a session idle 30 minutes switching into an organization with a 10-minute idle limit is answered `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, its row ends with `idle_timeout`, stays scoped to the old organization, and `last_activity_at` is unchanged; the control (idle 2 minutes) answers 200.

**D1:** `sys_session.revoke_reason`'s description names `ip_not_allowed` (`sys-session.object.ts`); the six translation bundles carry it (en regenerated by `check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, the other five hand-edited the same way).

**S6: the organization form's notices are removed.** `access_policy.mfa_required` has no reader a form notice would serve: its save refusal already names two-factor itself, and `sys_organization.require_mfa` is read-only and off the form, so nothing on the form turns the requirement on. Per the seat ruling, `organizationMfaNotices.ts`, its test, the `AppContent.tsx` call (the `findOne` of the stored column and the `description` spread on the save toast) and the two `console.organizationMfa.*` keys in all eleven packs are removed; the German quote-pairing census moves by one span.

New test files: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-access-policy-doors.test.ts` (D3 on a real better-auth instance, D2 through the route; a new file because #31175 is in flight on `organization-access-policy.test.ts`) and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/org-admin-client-address-read.dogfood.test.ts` (S7 end to end on a booted stack).

## Why

The card's acceptance: "An org admin reads their judged address; a plain member is refused." / "No dead notice code remains." D1, D2 and D3 are the should-fixes carried from the #31013 contract reviews.

## Tests

- `allowed-ip-ranges.pin.test.ts`: the organization read answers what the platform read and the save's judged address answer across three transports (peer, forwarded under `trustProxy`, forged header without it); the platform route refuses a non-platform-admin `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`; anonymous `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, plain member `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, held `403 MFA_REQUIRED`, each refused before the address is read; store outage `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`; three query parameters each `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`; the mount middleware's door (peer, forwarded, forged, unestablished, and none outside a mount).
- `organization-access-policy-doors.test.ts`: D3 (outside the list ends the session `ip_not_allowed` and the next read is null; an unestablished address is refused under a set list; no door, no IP judgement) and D2 (above).
- Every refusal case asserts `code` and `status`.

## Acceptance notes

- The console's Access policy page does not read the new route yet; this PR serves it. Seam: runtime `GET /api/v1/auth/client-address` → renderer SettingsView, `access_policy` namespace; consumer: none yet.
- `organization-access-policy.test.ts` › "the absolute limit is judged too…" failed once in the full plugin-auth run on a loaded box and passes alone: its fixture creates the session exactly 60 minutes ago and the judgement is a strict `>` against a one-hour limit, so any elapsed millisecond between insert and judgement flips `admitted` to `ended`. Not touched here (#31175 holds that file).
- `content/docs/**` teaches no per-organization access policy at all (only the deployment's own `allowed_ip_ranges`); noted, not changed here.

## Verification

Final head `78ac3b00` (the branch merged with `origin/main` once, after #31194 changed plugin-auth). Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

<details><summary>Red first and ablations</summary>

- Red first (the new tests against the base sources): 12 failed.
- `readMountDoor` in `customSession` replaced by `undefined`: 2 failed (`expected undefined to be 'ip_not_allowed'`), restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The mount middleware made to call bare `next()`: 3 failed (door undefined), restored.
- The `setup.write` check disabled: the plain-member case red (the address was read), restored.
- A heartbeat written before the switch judgement: the set-active case red (200, not 401), restored. A first attempt at this ablation was a no-op (its replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count stayed 1); re-run with a replacement that does not contain it, which landed and went red.

</details>

<details><summary>Suites, type-checks, lint</summary>

On `78ac3b00`:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: exit 0, Test Files 236 passed (236), Tests 4199 passed, 10 skipped.
- From `ui/`, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999.test.tsx`: exit 0, Test Files 99 passed (99), Tests 1756 passed, 13 skipped.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: exit 0, Test Files 119 passed (119), Tests 1701 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`): exit 0 each.
- Scoped lint: `eslint packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src packages/platform-objects/src` plus the new dogfood file `--no-inline-config`: exit 0, no output. From `ui/`, `eslint` on the edited `AppContent.tsx`, its test, the locale packs and the de-quote test: exit 0, 0 errors, 50 warnings, all on `AppContent.tsx` lines this PR does not edit.
- The full plugin-auth run on `0a6d22c6` had two reds: the route-ledger conformance pin (fixed in `4fd8b6be` by naming the new route) and the boundary flake named under Acceptance notes; both files pass on `78ac3b00`.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `78ac3b00`: 86 commands, each run with stdin from `/dev/null` and its exit captured before any pipe: 86 exit 0. `--ran` with each line recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`: "86 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 86 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". The lock's verdict: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

On the earlier head (78 commands), four reds were fixed before this run: `check:engine-double-contract` (the new test's doubles, ledger rewritten with `--write`), `check:test-source-alias` (a dynamic `@objectstack/core` import in a test body made static; the edited AppContent test warms `@objectstack/lint` at module top), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3 until the pinned fixture commit was fetched) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3 until the closure was built).

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery (final head)</summary>

`78ac3b00` · after `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` (exit 0) · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0` · Test Files 436 passed, 3 skipped (439) · Tests 3613 passed, 41 skipped (3654) · no failures. The new file alone: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 4 passed.
